name: get_global_stats
description: Check worldwide COVID-19 totals. Returns cumulative cases, deaths, recovered, active cases, plus today's new cases and deaths.

name: get_country_stats
description: Check COVID-19 stats for a specific country (e.g., "US", "India", "GB"). Returns cases, deaths, recovered, active cases, today's change, and population.

name: get_historical
description: Get daily COVID-19 timeline for a country or globally. Returns historical progression of cases, deaths, and recoveries by date.

country.description: Country name or "all" for global data (default: "all")

days.description: Number of days of history to return (default: 30)

name: get_vaccine_stats
description: Check COVID-19 vaccination progress for a country or globally. Returns cumulative doses administered daily over the past 30 days.

country.description: Country name to get vaccine data for. Omit for global totals.
